text:
Anna Chen: quick follow-up from today's UX pass — a few folks reported confusion around how tie-breaks and undo work when reordering rules in the editor.
Lina Gomez: customer asked if there's an easy way to revert a reorder mistake — they worried about accidental drops during fast edits.
Mike R: we should add a brief undo toast after a reorder: 'Moved rule X — Undo'. keep it non-blocking but visible for ~6s.
Sophia Patel: agree. also when two rules tie, show the explicit tie-break reason inline (e.g., 'tie: created earlier' or 'tie: manual override') so users know why one won. small tooltip can expand to the deterministic rules.
Derek Li: accessibility note: make sure the toast is announced via an aria-live polite region and includes an explicit action that is keyboard-focusable ('Undo').
Jin (designbot): a11y checklist: toast should be reachable by Tab and should not steal focus. announce 'Rule moved. Press undo to revert.' Use role=alertdialog only if user action is required; for non-blocking toasts use status live region.
Mike R: API surface idea: expose an operation id for reorder so UI can call 'reorder.undo(op_id)'. sample response shape:
```
{
  "op_id": "op-2024-11-13-773",
  "final_sort": ["r-1","r-42","r-7"],
  "message": "reorder applied"
}
```
Sophia Patel: simulation UX: when running the preview in draft mode, show a compact diff between 'saved' and 'draft' ordering and a toggle 'Apply undo history to this simulation' so people can test with or without recent undos.
Anna Chen: copy tweak: change floating button from 'Run sim' to 'Run simulation (draft)' and add a secondary tiny link 'Run saved' next to it. avoids the confusion of stale results.
Derek Li: simulator stability: add a short debounce when draft changes and show a thin skeleton in the preview list during compilation. also show per-sample 'why matched' explainer that includes tie-break reason when applicable.
Sophia Patel: microcopy for tie badge: 'Tie-break: {reason}'. compact form 'Tie: {reason}'. Tooltip text: 'Deterministic order applied when priority equals — details: {explanation}'.
Mike R: implementation note — I'll wire op_id into the reorder response and add the undo toast + keyboard-accessible Undo button. will also include analytics event 'reorder.undo' so we can see frequency.
Anna Chen: plan: Mike -> undo toast + op_id wiring + analytics; Derek -> aria-live + keyboard focus rules for toast; Sophia -> tie-break copy + diff UI + help snippet; Lina -> write a short customer-facing blurb for release notes about undo and draft simulation clarity. demo next Tue 9am. Thanks all :sparkles:
